_about: lanePROPVIS: config of the -propvis:<dir> harness (PropVis.cs). The mode is OFF unless the player is started with -propvis:<outdir>; this file only holds numbers. enabled=false makes the mode exit at once. id.width/height = size of the ID pass (override: -propvissize:WxH); counts are scaled to the reference output refWidth x refHeight (2560x1600) so 'pixels' always means pixels of the real frame. A 1280x800 id pass = 4 reference pixels per id pixel, so a prop of 20 reference pixels is 5 id pixels (a smaller id pass would hide the tier B band). budgetSec = soft time budget (phases stop and write what they have), timeoutSec = hard stop; the whole run is meant to take under 15 minutes. shot = the normal screenshot per camera (offscreen RT of the real main camera). shadow = visible-surface grid (gridX x gridY points per camera) and the ray-to-sun test against prop bounds; maxCasterM = longest shadow ray, maxDistanceM 0 = read HDShadowSettings.maxShadowDistance from the volume stack; every = shadow on every Nth camera.
